name: Marubun Corporation
summary: Marubun Corporation distributes electronics products in Japan and internationally. The company offers semiconductors and electronic components, including amplifiers, clocks, wired and wireless interfaces, isolation products, microcontroller processors, motor drivers, power supplies, RF and microwave, sensors, ASIC/FPGA/PLDs, memories, displays, ASSP, discrete products, protective elements, passive components, connector and switches, circuit boards and heat sinks.
